usageNotes: Use this to get a real-time health snapshot of a specific cluster node, including CPU usage, memory, root filesystem, load averages, kernel version, and boot mode. The node must be online and reachable by the cluster; if the node is offline, the API will return an error rather than stale data. Requires Sys.Audit on /nodes/{node}.
tips: cpu is a float between 0 and 1 (e.g., 0.42 = 42% utilization) — multiply by 100 for a percentage display.
memory.available is the kernel-reported available memory (includes reclaimable caches), which is typically larger than memory.free; prefer available for headroom estimates.
loadavg returns three strings for 1-, 5-, and 15-minute averages — parse as floats before comparing to cpuinfo.cpus to gauge saturation.
boot-info.secureboot is only present when boot-info.mode is 'efi'; absence of the field implies legacy-BIOS or secure boot not detected.
rootfs reflects the root partition only (/); storage pools like local-lvm or ZFS datasets are not included here — use storage status endpoints for those.
